gaps.lead: The bad weather meant we couldn't leave the house.
No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.

gaps.lead: It's a pity I didn't bring my camera.
gaps.explanation: 'If only I had brought' expresses regret about the past.

gaps.lead: I regret not bringing an umbrella.
gaps.explanation: Regret about the past: wish + subject + had + participle.

gaps.lead: We wanted to continue our mountain trek but the weather was too bad.
gaps.sentence: We ___ on with our mountain trek but the weather was too bad.
gaps.hint: unfulfilled wish: would have liked to
gaps.explanation: An unrealised wish about the past: 'would have liked to carry on'.

gaps.lead: It took the artist three weeks to paint the mural.
gaps.explanation: it took X time to do = X spent time doing: spent over three weeks on.
